test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CART : UTDG :: DREW : XGUH :: ENDS : ?
solution:
The position and positional value of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, CART : UTDG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d7357b73df39b9777ddda2c7f0212f1ab96464bf9ebc1c653e39a3c8112a7e.png] 

For, DREW : XGUH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb48a0d8a4adcda0c0443cceeba65340eff4fefe7a3296e8fb0325b79adc85ca.png] 

Similarly, ENDS will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4afd660100f5121a69a8233d1ca29391b1109e6c16455cfb3de3e33e55a11f5.png] 

So, ENDS will be TFQI.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
